exposure: Double-layer uterine closure with locking in the first layer
cohort: 225 women aged 18-45 years, gestational weeks 24-41 of singleton pregnancies, undergoing their first cesarean delivery
finding: There was no significant difference in uterine scar niche development between single- and double-layer uterine closure techniques.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effects of single- and double-layer uterine closure techniques following cesarean delivery, finding no significant difference in uterine scar niche development between the two techniques.
